summary: John's maternal 4th great-grandfather; earliest known Giannetta ancestor, of Bisaccia.
bio: New generation found in Round 3. Dead by 20 Jul 1867 when his son Savino married (Bisaccia Matrimoni 1867 act 17). Wife Lucia Macchia(?) (reading uncertain). His grandson Frank was named Francesco after him.
